issues.description: The problem statement uses two different method names for the animal feeding sound: messageOnFeed() (UML and Part 1) and getFeedingSound() (individual animal descriptions, feedAllAnimals description, and song template). The provided solution classes (Animal and Farm) implement and call messageOnFeed(), but the mixed naming in the problem text may confuse students about which method to implement and which method Farm should call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) change all occurrences of getFeedingSound() in the problem statement to messageOnFeed(), or (B) rename the abstract method and all calls in template/solution to getFeedingSound(). Update the song template text in the problem statement to refer to the chosen method name so students clearly know which method to implement and call.
